# Incremental Value

Incremental Value is an end-to-end D2C Growth Partner in India, founded by Deepak Gupta. We help e-commerce founders scale profitably by fixing unit economics, tracking, and media buying.

- Growth Partnership (Meta Ads, Google Ads, Q-commerce)
- D2C Tech Setup (CAPI, n8n)
